v26_spawn_claim.description: Run while standing inside the overworld spawn chunks, which a dedicated server never unloads. Claims a pig there so a later bundle can look it up by UUID from another dimension.

v26_lookup_from_nether.description: Run while standing in the Nether. Looks the overworld pig up by UUID. Expect the NBT and INSPECT records to carry dimension=0 while the sender is in -1.

v26_cleanup.description: Run back in the overworld near the pig. Removes it and stops the session.
